intro: After Encroaching Wildlife, Watcher Biggs has a further matter for you. Stunned in the Lost Ones' attack on the caravan, Biggs still saw a wagon hauled off to the Fallow Sanctuary, the Lost Ones' village in the north. A chest of valuable reagents rode in it, and Biggs wants those reagents brought back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was stunned during the attack by the Lost Ones, but before my sight went black I spied one of our wagons being dragged to the Fallow Sanctuary, the lost one village to the north.

A caravan chest with valuable reagents was in that wagon, reagents vital to the studies of the wizards of Nethergarde Keep. Find the chest and get those reagents, friend. Get them and bring them to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the wizard's reagents, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you found them! With these, the wizards in Nethergarde may continue their work. I do not know what it is that they do, but it is linked to the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands, and is vital to the security of the Alliance.
